text: Stand the motorcycle upright on a firm, level surface. Clean the filler cap before you remove it, and keep water and dust out of the reservoir when you refill. Front: with the reservoir horizontal, the fluid level should be at the center of the window, which the manual treats as the minimum level. Rear: with the reservoir horizontal, the fluid level should be between the "MAX" and "Min" marks. Use only DOT 4 brake fluid from a sealed container, and refill with the same type. Watch out: An insufficient brake fluid level will cause the brake system to fail. Watch out: Brake fluid is highly corrosive and can damage painted parts. If it spills, clean the area at once with a soft cloth, preferably wet. Watch out: Do not let brake fluid touch your skin, eyes or clothing, and keep it out of the reach of children. Watch out: Do not mix DOT 4 with other brake fluid. The front check gives only a minimum level, with no upper mark for the front reservoir in this procedure.
